<issue>
test_s3_snapshot (deadlock) hangs on SAVE to S3 (helio client)
Happens in (selected occurrences):
https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/actions/runs/29059986494
https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/actions/runs/29068786198
https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/actions/runs/29173600440

Suspected:  from a fast analysis seems like the cause for this deadlock is merged PR #7807 (which includes helio bump) 

- `SAVE DF s3://…/snapshot` never returns 
- server alive but SAVE fiber never completes. 
- Bisect: last green `ba0879179` is the direct parent of first-red `258e596` (#7807), which bumped helio `e16b6cfe→c054a1ac` (#603/#605/#606/#607/#609 — proactor/fiber completion). 19+ consecutive nightly failures; not disk-full; reproduces on ARM64 **and** x86.

Disabled the test test_s3_snapshot.
Enable back when issue is fixed.


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (dragonfly repo), find the disabled test test_s3_snapshot (tests/dragonfly/*.py) and show how it's disabled (skip marker). Also find S3 snapshot write code (src/server/detail/save_stages_controller.cc, src/server/snapshot / aws s3 write file in src/server/*s3*). Report the skip marker text with file and line, and the relevant code of the S3 write file Close/Write path.
